sentences.en: Jimmy is to some extent capable of performing this operation.
sentences.zh: 吉米在某种程度上能够完成这项操作。

sentences.en: The mayor compromised on the subject to a certain extent.
sentences.zh: 市长在这一问题上做出了某些妥协。

sentences.en: The teacher was surprised at the extent of his knowledge.
sentences.zh: 老师对他知识的程度感到惊讶。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ex（出）+tent（伸展）→伸展出的距离→范围，广度
